blocks.prompt: 2 (a) The displacement-time graph of a moving car is shown in Fig. 7.10. The car changes its direction during the journey, and its motion occurs in three distinct phases. What is the car's velocity in each phase?
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein formula nahi, graph diya gaya hai, aur humein graph parh kar har phase ki velocity nikalni hai.
Diya kya hai? Figure 7.10; ek chhota square time mein 1 unit aur displacement mein 10 km ka hai.
Find kya karna hai? Teeno phases ki alag alag velocity.
Rule: displacement-time graph ka slope velocity hota hai.
Plan: pehle kone wale points parhein, phir har seedhe hisse ka slope nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: Figure 7.10 ka displacement-time graph.
Maloom karna: har phase ki velocity.
Tareeqa: velocity = displacement-time graph ka slope (7.1.4). Har phase ek seedhi line hai, is liye har phase mein velocity constant hai; bas har line ka slope ek dafa nikalna hai.

Kone wale points parhein
\[O(0, 0),\ A(3, 60)\]
\[B(7, 0),\ C\left(\tfrac{26}{3}, -25\right)\]
Kyun: line \(t = 3\) par sab se oonche point 60 km tak jati hai (A). Phir neeche aati hai, grid point (5, 30) se guzarti hai, \(t = 7\) par time axis ko kaat'ti hai (B), aur \(-20\) aur \(-30\) wali lines ke beech mein khatam hoti hai (C). Teen phases: O se A, A se B, aur B se C.
Dhyan dein: scale ghaur se dekhein. Ek square upar ki taraf 10 km hai, 1 km nahi.

Phase 1 (O se A)
\[v_1 = \dfrac{60 - 0}{3 - 0}\]
\[= 20\text{ km/h}\]
Kyun: oopar jati hui line ka slope positive hota hai, matlab car start se door ja rahi hai, aage ki taraf.

Phase 2 (A se B)
\[v_2 = \dfrac{0 - 60}{7 - 3}\]
\[= \dfrac{-60}{4} = -15\text{ km/h}\]
Kyun: neeche aati hui line ka slope negative hota hai. Matlab car mur chuki hai aur wapas start ki taraf aa rahi hai. Minus sign sirf direction batata hai; raftaar 15 km/h hai.

Phase 3 (B se C)
\[v_3 = \dfrac{-25 - 0}{\frac{26}{3} - 7}\]
\[= \dfrac{-25}{5/3} = -15\text{ km/h}\]
Kyun: B se C bhi usi seedhi line par hai jis par A se B hai, is liye slope wohi rehta hai. Farq sirf position ka hai: phase 2 mein car start ke qareeb aa rahi thi, phase 3 mein woh start se guzar kar doosri taraf ja rahi hai, jahan \(x\) negative hai.

Tasdeeq: grid point (5, 30) se
\[\dfrac{30 - 60}{5 - 3} = -15 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: ek hi seedhi line ke koi bhi do points lein, slope ek jaisa aata hai. Is se humari parhai hui values pakki ho gayin.
blocks.final_answer: Phase 1: \(20\) km/h; phase 2: \(-15\) km/h; phase 3: \(-15\) km/h (minus ka matlab hai 15 km/h ki raftaar se peeche ki taraf)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 7.10 mein displacement km mein hai lekin time seconds (s) mein likha hai. Is hisaab se car ki pehli velocity 20 km har second (yani 72 000 km/h) banti, jo kisi car ke liye na-mumkin hai. Is liye time ko ghanton (hours) mein parhna chahiye, aur hum velocities km/h mein dete hain. (Agar koi printed seconds hi rakhe to is page ka har number wahi rehta hai, sirf km/h ki jagah km/s aa jata hai.) Figure yeh bhi nahi batati ke safar kahan khatam hota hai; hum drawn line ka aakhri point \(x = -25\) km lete hain, jahan line \(t = 26/3\) h par pohanchti hai. Hamari Figure 7.10 mein time axis ghanton (hours) mein likha hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (b) The displacement-time graph of a moving car is shown in Fig. 7.10. The car changes its direction during the journey, and its motion occurs in three distinct phases. When did the car pass its starting point again?
blocks.explanation:
Car apne starting point par tab hoti hai jab us ka displacement dobara zero ho jaye.
Diya kya hai? A(3, 60) se guzarti hui neeche aane wali line, jis ka slope \(-15\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? Woh time jab \(x = 0\) ho.
Plan: line ki equation likhein aur us mein \(x = 0\) rakh dein.
steps:
Diya gaya: neeche aane wali line \(A(3, 60)\) se guzarti hai aur slope \(-15\) hai.
Maloom karna: woh time \(t > 0\) jab \(x = 0\).
Tareeqa: starting point par displacement 0 hota hai, yani graph time axis ko chhoota hai. Graph se bhi parh sakte hain, lekin equation se jawab pakka ho jata hai.

Neeche aane wali line ki equation
\[x - 60 = -15(t - 3)\]
\[x = 105 - 15t\]
Kyun: seedhi line ki point-slope form lagayi, point A aur woh slope jo part (a) mein nikla. Phir bracket khol kar \(x\) ko akela kiya: \(-15t + 45 + 60\).

\(x = 0\) rakhein
\[0 = 105 - 15t\]
\[t = 7\]
Kyun: displacement zero ka matlab hai car wapas apni shuru wali jagah par hai. 105 ko 15 se divide kiya to 7 mila.

Tasdeeq
\[x(7) = 105 - 105 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: graph bhi time axis ko \(t = 7\) par kaat'ta hai (point B). Yahan car rukti nahi, seedhi aage peeche ki taraf nikal jati hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(t = 7\) h par (point B); us ke baad car start se guzar kar peeche ki taraf chalti rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (c) The displacement-time graph of a moving car is shown in Fig. 7.10. The car changes its direction during the journey, and its motion occurs in three distinct phases. What is the total distance travelled?
blocks.explanation:
Distance scalar hai: is mein direction nahi dekhi jati, har hissa positive gina jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Teen phases: O se A, A se B, B se C.
Find kya karna hai? Car ne kul kitna raasta tay kiya.
Plan: har phase mein displacement ki tabdeeli ka size (absolute value) le kar sab ko jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: O(0, 0), A(3, 60), B(7, 0), C(26/3, -25).
Maloom karna: total distance.
Tareeqa: distance = raaste ki kul lambai, direction ki parwah kiye baghair (7.1.1). Is liye har phase ke displacement ka size le kar jama karte hain.

Har hisse ka size
\[O \to A:\ |60 - 0| = 60\]
\[A \to B:\ |0 - 60| = 60\]
\[B \to C:\ |-25 - 0| = 25\]
Kyun: absolute value minus sign hata deti hai aur sirf lambai rehne deti hai. Socho ke car ke meter (odometer) par yeh teeno faasle jur jate hain, chahe car aage jaye ya peeche.

Jama karein
\[60 + 60 + 25 = 145\text{ km}\]
Kyun: car ne teeno hisse waqai tay kiye, is liye teeno ginay jayenge.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(-25\) ko minus mein nahi lena; distance kabhi kam nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[145 \ge |-25| \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: distance kabhi bhi total displacement ke size se chhota nahi ho sakta. Yahan 145 bara hai 25 se, to jawab maqool hai. Dono sirf tab barabar hote hain jab object kabhi wapas na mude, jaise Question 1 mein Junaid.

blocks.prompt: 2 (d) The displacement-time graph of a moving car is shown in Fig. 7.10. The car changes its direction during the journey, and its motion occurs in three distinct phases. What is the average velocity?
blocks.explanation:
Average velocity mein displacement istemal hota hai, distance nahi; is liye ulti directions wale hisse ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain.
Diya kya hai? Car \(t = 0\) par \(x = 0\) se chali aur \(t = 26/3\) h par \(x = -25\) km par khatam hui.
Find kya karna hai? Average velocity.
Plan: total displacement ko total time se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: start \(O(0, 0)\), end \(C\left(\frac{26}{3}, -25\right)\).
Maloom karna: average velocity.
Tareeqa: \(v_{avg} = \frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}\) (7.1.3). Is formula mein sirf pehli aur aakhri position chahiye, beech ka raasta nahi.

Total displacement
\[\Delta x = -25 - 0 = -25\text{ km}\]
Kyun: 60 km aage aur 60 km wapas ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain; bas aakhri 25 km peeche ki taraf bachte hain. Isi liye displacement ka jawab distance (145 km) se bilkul mukhtalif hai.

Total time
\[\Delta t = \dfrac{26}{3}\text{ h}\]
Kyun: poore safar ka waqt shuru se line ke aakhir tak ginna hai. B ke baad 25 km ko 15 km/h se tay karne mein \(\frac{25}{15} = \frac{5}{3}\) h lagte hain, to \(t = 7 + \frac{5}{3} = \frac{26}{3}\).

Average velocity
\[v_{avg} = \dfrac{-25}{26/3}\]
\[= -\dfrac{75}{26} \approx -2.88\]
Kyun: fraction se divide karna us ke ulte (reciprocal) se multiply karna hai: \(-25 \times \frac{3}{26}\). Minus sign batata hai ke kul mila kar car peeche ki taraf khiski.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{slope of } OC = \dfrac{-25}{26/3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: average velocity pehle aur aakhri point ko milane wali line ka slope hoti hai, aur wohi aaya. Farq bhi dekh lein: average speed \(145 \div \frac{26}{3} \approx 16.73\) km/h hoti, kyunke speed mein distance lagta hai, displacement nahi.
